description: Report, on behalf of the client, that the professional did not show up (reason=provider_no_show) or that the session was cancelled/not delivered (reason=cancelled). Creates a Dispute(OPEN) for the org to review — it does NOT change the session status. Idempotent: if an open dispute already exists for the session, returns alreadyReported=true with its disputeId. Notifies the org.
name: portal_report_session
